evidence.official: Patch 1.17 (live 2026-09-22) and 1.16.4 articles as collected 2026-09-23 14:24 CDT, fingerprints 271b9e0e… (1.17) and 0ca8b107… (1.16.4). No hotfix published; confirmed on predecessorgame.com 2026-09-23.
evidence.mechanics: Pred.gg public definitions collected by the Windows app 2026-09-23 14:24 CDT (evidence/windows-bronze-2313.json), cross-checked against Omeda and the official notes.
evidence.pred_117: Pred.gg 1.17 ranked Bronze+ role and item-position samples, 2026-09-23 14:24 CDT. The only current-patch outcome sample available; Pred.gg returned no structured data to later automated requests, which was respected.
evidence.statz: Statz dataset labelled 1.16, collected 2026-09-23 14:52–14:56 CDT for all six ranks; broad dataset, previous patch.
evidence.limitation: No Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists. Loadout (augment/Eternal) evidence is 1.16 only; 1.17 reduced Weald, Satariel and Lich, which is weighed where those variants lead.

aurora|jungle.reasoning: Hypothermia has no recorded games in any rank (0 of 3,982 Gold+ games in 1.16) and the Fire Blossom opener appears in 10 of 447 current-patch Bronze+ games. Glacial Thorns carries the role in every rank (1.16 Gold+ 52.2–55.8% across Krix, Vesh and Lotus; Silver+ 54.7%), and 1.17 Bronze+ opens Magnify (276 games, 53.6%). Glacial Thorns adds a root at the dash origin to a kit already built on the ring root and the ultimate stun, which Spectral Schematics converts into damage. The 1.17 Shatter on-hit trim does not affect this ability-led path.
aurora|jungle.alternative: Glacial Thorns with Lotus (Masterpiece + Immaculate) and a Spirit Of Amir opener led Gold+ at 55.8% over 787 games in 1.16; take it for a damage-first clear when the lane can hold without your durability. Crystalline Cuirass replaces Flux Matrix against heavy magic damage.
aurora|jungle.limitation: Loadout comparison is from the 1.16 Statz dataset; no Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists.

boris|jungle.reasoning: Apex Hunter with Weald beats the plan's Apex Hunter with Thraex by about ten points in every rank with meaningful samples (1.16: Gold+ 55.6% over 2,943 vs 45.3% over 1,819; Bronze+ 57.9% vs 45.1%; Silver+ 54.9% vs 45.8%; Platinum+ 55.2% vs 43.1%). The 1.17 Wind-Rider cut (20%→15% attack speed) is small beside that gap. Boris scales through on-hit canisters and attack speed, which Weald's missiles and Dryad's Boon reward. Rapture (attack speed, health, omnivamp, on-hit damage near targets) replaces Basilisk, which is weak in current 1.17 Bronze+ data (58 games, 37.9%).
boris|jungle.alternative: Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity) with Basilisk remains a durable duel option, but it has trailed Weald in every sampled rank. Move Citadel earlier against physical burst.
boris|jungle.limitation: Loadout comparison is from 1.16 Statz; Weald was reduced in 1.17 and no Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists.

zarus|jungle.reasoning: The Flow State + Thraex pair sits at 47–48% in every rank (1.16: Gold+ 47.8% over 910, Bronze+ 48.2%, Silver+ 47.5%, Platinum+ 47.3%). The same augment on Lotus reaches 57.8% over 979 Gold+ games and 55.9% over 980 Platinum+ games, and Lotus was not changed in 1.17. Early Bloom's extra level and Immaculate's damage reduction while healthy suit an arena engage from full health. The item path already matches what winning players buy.
zarus|jungle.alternative: The Ascended with Lotus (52.0% Gold+, 57.6% Silver+) scales without needing Evade resets. Tainted Blade replaces Basilisk against real healing.
zarus|jungle.limitation: Loadout comparison is from 1.16 Statz; no Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists.

serath|jungle.reasoning: Crushing Descent with Weald leads the plan's Thraex version in all four large samples (1.16: Gold+ 55.0% over 4,560 vs 52.3% over 2,017; Bronze+ 57.4% vs 51.0%; Silver+ 56.4% vs 48.2%; Platinum+ 54.0% vs 46.3%). 1.17 trims Serath's on-hit scaling and Wind-Rider, which apply to both loadouts, and fixes Weald missiles against proc damage in its favour. The existing items already match the winning variant.
serath|jungle.alternative: Vital Resonance with Weald (56.4% Gold+) trades the Ascend stun for visage healing. Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) is the steadier duel loadout but has trailed Weald in every rank.
serath|jungle.limitation: Loadout comparison is from 1.16 Statz; no Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists.

feng-mao|jungle.reasoning: Augmentation is almost never bought on Feng Mao (2 of 370 current-patch Bronze+ games; absent from every Statz variant), while Omen is the established second item (182 games, 48.9% in 1.17 Bronze+; core in every Gold+ Satariel variant). Omen's momentum-empowered attack and 20% non-ultimate cooldown refund suit his cast-and-attack weaving better than a bruiser attack-speed item. Legacy and Salvation were unobserved; Nightfall's ability healing and takedown shield support the reset pattern. The Imperial Duelist + Thraex duel theme is coherent and unrefuted and is retained.
feng-mao|jungle.alternative: Imperial Duelist with Satariel (Demonic Bargain + Psychosis) is the most-played setup (1.16 Gold+ 51.6% over 1,776, Silver+ 54.0%); 1.17 trimmed Satariel. Manta Scythe replaces Malady for faster clears.
feng-mao|jungle.limitation: No sample exists for the Thraex loadout; the items rest on 1.17 Bronze+ and 1.16 Statz evidence.

kallari|jungle.reasoning: Augmentation (1 of 224 current-patch games) and Deathstalker (7 games, 42.9%) are not how Kallari is played; Malady > Vanquisher > Spear Of Desolation is the core of every Gold+ variant, and Vanquisher is the 1.17 Bronze+ second item (179 games, 54.7%). Vanquisher's execute finishes the delayed mark and Spear's ultimate haste returns it sooner. The Deadly Finesse + Thraex loadout is coherent and unrefuted and is retained.
kallari|jungle.alternative: Deadly Finesse with Satariel (Hellfire Strikes + Psychosis) is the most-played loadout (1.16 Gold+ 50.9%, Platinum+ 53.6%); 1.17 trimmed Satariel. Move Mesmer ahead of The Perforator when a single spell blocks entry.
kallari|jungle.limitation: No sample exists for the Thraex loadout.

rampage|jungle.reasoning: The Rock & Awe + Krix pair itself is sound in Gold+ (56.0% over 899 in 1.16) and is retained. Its Fire Blossom > Dynamo opening is almost never bought (11 and 2 of 303 current-patch Bronze+ games), while every variant in every rank opens Overlord > Rapture > Cursed Scroll, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms Overlord (378 games) and Rapture (177 games, 54.2%). Overlord's health scaling feeds Rampage's durability and boulder engages without spending a second item on a catch-only payoff.
rampage|jungle.alternative: Tiny Titan (Regenerative Tissue + Cannibalism) is the most-played loadout (1.16 Gold+ 55.5% over 5,945) for an attack-speed duel pattern that accepts 40% more damage taken.
rampage|jungle.limitation: Item evidence for Gold+ is 1.16 Statz; 1.17 evidence is Bronze+.

khaimera|jungle.reasoning: Jungle Invasion + Thraex is observed and strong in Gold+ (52.9% over 2,114 in 1.16; Silver+ 56.0%), with Overlord and Basilisk in its core. The plan deliberately skips Rapture: extra attack speed is wasted inside Unleash's cap, and Draconum's healing ramp feeds Invigorate. 1.17 does not change the relevant mechanics.
khaimera|jungle.alternative: Jungle Invasion with Satariel led a smaller Platinum+ sample (57.8% over 836); Feral Ambush + Thraex is the most-played setup (50.5% Gold+).

grux|jungle.reasoning: Sky Splitter and Basilisk match the observed core in every rank, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms Sky Splitter (285 games, 55.1%). The only same-augment comparison (Silver+ Lust For Blood) shows Thraex no worse than Vermis (48.9% vs 47.5%). Rapture is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (162 games, 43.2%), so Mutilator's health-scaling hits remain the third item.
grux|jungle.alternative: Red Mist with Weald (1.16 Gold+ 54.6% over 876) fits a team fight around several bleeding targets; Weald was reduced in 1.17.

kwang|jungle.reasoning: Spirit Of Amir > Oathkeeper matches every observed variant. Nihil is unobserved, but the observed Vesh setup is not better (44–48% in 1.16 Gold+, Silver+, Platinum+), so nothing refutes the sustained-fight choice. Role performance is below 50% in every sampled rank, so this is a situational pick.
kwang|jungle.alternative: Slayer of the Heavens with Vesh (Tithe of Death + Millennia) and Gaussian Greaves is the observed setup.
kwang|jungle.limitation: Kwang Jungle performs below 50% in every sampled rank; the Nihil loadout has no sample.

riktor|jungle.reasoning: Wanton Warden is unobserved, but the 1.16 Zap O' 9-Chains core (Elafrost, Spectral Schematics) performs poorly in current 1.17 Bronze+ data (43.5% and 30.6%), while the plan's Fire Blossom opener performs better (58 games, 51.7%). The hook-and-hold tank plan is coherent; the evidence does not justify a switch.
riktor|jungle.alternative: Zap O' 9-Chains with Elafrost > Spectral Schematics > Gaia Greaves is the 1.16 observed setup (48.4% Gold+).
riktor|jungle.limitation: Riktor Jungle performs below 50% in most sampled ranks; small current-patch samples.

scarlett|jungle.reasoning: Low-confidence role: 1.16 samples are poor in every rank (39–42%, tier D) and 1.17 Bronze+ is 49.2% over 252 games. The plan's bruiser items are rarely bought, but no evidence contradicts them, and the disputed Ashen Vow fields remain excluded from calculations as before. Retained with an explicit limitation rather than replaced by an equally weak observed path.
scarlett|jungle.alternative: 1.17 Bronze+ players open Alternator (100 games, 59.0%) and add The Perforator or Tainted Blade.
scarlett|jungle.limitation: Low-confidence role; the plan's items have almost no sample and Ashen Vow base-damage fields remain disputed.

sevarog|jungle.reasoning: Grim Harvest + Krix is the only observed loadout and Fire Blossom the observed opener; Fist Of Razuul replaces Elafrost, which is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (47 games, 31.9%). Souls still require ability last hits.
sevarog|jungle.alternative: Elafrost second is the 1.16 observed path (47.8% Gold+).

yin|jungle.reasoning: The plan is the observed loadout in every rank (Storm of Salvation + Weald: 1.16 Gold+ 53.3% over 2,057, Silver+ 55.1%) and its items lead 1.17 Bronze+ (Sky Splitter 59.4%, Onixian Quiver 54.8%). Forage and Taproot were trimmed in 1.17; Dryad's Boon is the tempo alternative.
yin|jungle.alternative: Tainted Rounds is the common third item against healing.

crunch|jungle.reasoning: Combo Crunch + Thraex is the observed Gold+ loadout (50.4%) and the plan keeps its Augmentation and Salvation; 1.17 Bronze+ supports Augmentation (112 games) and Mutilator (40 games, 62.5%).
crunch|jungle.alternative: Berserker's Axe is the common opener (1.17 Bronze+ 113 games, 45.1%).

greystone|jungle.reasoning: Close Cut + Thraex with Overlord > Augmentation > Basilisk is the only observed setup (Bronze+ 48.0%, Silver+ 45.3%); the plan follows it. A reviewed 18-level order already exists.
greystone|jungle.alternative: Salvation is the observed defensive fourth item.
greystone|jungle.limitation: Role performs below 50%; no Gold+ Statz sample.

terra|jungle.reasoning: Too few games to test (35 in 1.17 Bronze+; no Statz page); the plan's Elafrost opener is the most-bought first item in that small sample.
terra|jungle.alternative: Gaia Greaves second is the small-sample alternative.
terra|jungle.limitation: Almost no sample in any rank.

yurei|jungle.reasoning: Low-confidence role: the observed assassin path performs poorly in 1.16 (Bronze+ 41.6%, Silver+ 43.8%, tier D) and 1.17 Bronze+ is 50.0% over 198 games. The plan's bruiser path with Soul Weaver's damage reduction is coherent but rarely bought; nothing contradicts it.
yurei|jungle.alternative: The observed path is Malady > Spear Of Desolation > The Perforator with Vesh.
yurei|jungle.limitation: Low-confidence role; the plan's items have almost no sample.

wukong|jungle.reasoning: The plan's items (Mindrazor, Augmentation, The Perforator) match observed cores. Its Thraex pair is weak in Bronze+ (41.1% over 725), but the only better loadouts come from small Platinum+ samples (Demiurge 56.2% over 290, Satariel 57.1% over 126). The skill schedule stays deliberately unavailable because of the six-rank spirit abilities.
wukong|jungle.alternative: Masterful Mimicry with Demiurge (Tri-Core + Bloatware) led Platinum+.
wukong|jungle.limitation: Wukong's 1.17 durability cuts and small samples; no Gold+ Statz sample.

akeron|jungle.reasoning: Too few games to test (81 in 1.17 Bronze+; no Statz page). The tank plan is coherent with the 1.17 scaling reductions, which lower his ability damage rather than his catch.
akeron|jungle.alternative: Small samples lean toward Megacosm magic damage.
akeron|jungle.limitation: Almost no sample in any rank.

bayle|jungle.reasoning: Betrayer's Reqiuem is the observed augment and Basilisk the observed second item (1.17 Bronze+ 52.0%); the plan's Knell loadout is unobserved, and the observed Thraex version is poor (42–44%). Nothing better is evidenced.
bayle|jungle.alternative: Earthshaker opener with Thraex is the observed setup.
bayle|jungle.limitation: Role performs below 50%; no Gold+ Statz sample.

countess|jungle.reasoning: Sanguine Slash + Vesh is observed (Bronze+ 48.0%, Silver+ 46.2%) and Spirit Of Amir the dominant opener (1.17 Bronze+ 244 games). Oblivion Crown performs well in 1.17 Bronze+ (56 games, 60.7%).
countess|jungle.alternative: Wraith Leggings and Noxia are the observed second and third items.

shinbi|jungle.reasoning: 1.17 Bronze+ Shinbi Jungle wins 58.8% over 85 games with exactly the plan's Spirit Of Amir > Oathkeeper > Magnify path. The Allegro + Aion loadout is unobserved but coherent for repeated Rushing Beat casts.
shinbi|jungle.alternative: Crescendo with Vesh is the 1.16 observed loadout (Bronze+ 47.2%).
shinbi|jungle.limitation: Small samples; no Gold+ Statz sample.

steel|jungle.reasoning: No Statz role sample; the plan's Fire Blossom opener is the most-bought first item in 1.17 Bronze+ (56 of 71 games, 51.8%). A reviewed 18-level order already exists.
steel|jungle.alternative: Elafrost second is the small-sample alternative.

lt-belica|midlane.reasoning: Combat Veteran with Lotus wins 62.3% over 775 Gold+ games and 60.2% over 756 Platinum+ games (1.16), against the plan's Devastating Bombs with Vesh at 50.3% and 50.8%, on the same item core. Steady experience plus Early Bloom's extra level at 12 brings a burst mage to higher ability ranks sooner; Lotus was not changed in 1.17.
lt-belica|midlane.alternative: Devastating Bombs with Vesh (The Tenth Seal + Mind Rot) remains the most-played isolated-burst setup (50.3% Gold+).
lt-belica|midlane.limitation: Loadout comparison is from 1.16 Statz; no Gold+ 1.17 outcome sample exists.

gadget|midlane.reasoning: Auto-Lock Amp leads the plan's Blast Zone in every rank (1.16 Gold+ 52.7% over 3,996 vs 46.7% over 1,681; Bronze+ 53.5% vs 49.6%; Silver+ 50.4% vs 47.9%). Players open Azure Core > Entropy > Overseer in every rank; Megacosm, the plan's opener, was unchanged in 1.17; in every rank it is bought third against health stacking, not first, and Dreambinder appears in 4 of 539 current-patch Bronze+ games. The 1.17 empowered-mine buff helps both augments.
gadget|midlane.alternative: Auto-Lock Amp with Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus) and a Soulbinder opener suits long-range poke (Silver+ 55.1%).

neon|midlane.reasoning: Ghost in the Machine is the weakest observed Neon loadout in every rank (1.16 Gold+ 43.5%, Bronze+ 41.5%, Silver+ 42.4%, Platinum+ 43.3%), 4-7 points below RAM with the same Vesh Eternal. Players open Combustion > Wraith Leggings > Amulet Of Chaos; Megacosm, the plan's opener, was unchanged in 1.17; in every rank it is bought third against health stacking, not first, and Timewarp as an opener is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (37 games, 35.1%).
neon|midlane.alternative: RAM with Aion and an Oathkeeper > Timewarp opener is the other common setup (Platinum+ 50.9%).
neon|midlane.limitation: Neon Mid performs below 50% in most ranks; comparison is from 1.16 Statz.

the-fey|midlane.reasoning: Wild Growth with Aion leads the plan's Natural Infusion with Vesh in three of four ranks (1.16 Gold+ 52.6% vs 50.2%, Bronze+ 58.0% vs 48.5%, Silver+ 54.4% vs 48.3%; level in Platinum+). Every variant opens Combustion > Wraith Leggings > Megacosm, confirmed in 1.17 Bronze+ (Combustion 593 games 55.0%, Wraith Leggings 361 games 54.6%); Dreambinder second appears in 11 games.
the-fey|midlane.alternative: Wild Growth with Vesh (Tithe of Death + Mind Rot) is the most-played setup (50.5% Gold+).

countess|midlane.reasoning: Every variant in every rank opens Combustion > Noxia > Wraith Leggings, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms it (Combustion 220 games, Noxia 51.0%, Wraith Leggings 63.9%). The plan's Megacosm opener appears in 6 current-patch games and World Breaker in 4. The Sanguine Slash + Vesh loadout is observed and retained.
countess|midlane.alternative: Shadow Echo with Vesh is the most-played loadout (46.1% Gold+).

howitzer|midlane.reasoning: Combat Thrusters with Vesh is the only Gold+ loadout and is retained. Its observed core is Combustion > Wraith Leggings > Noxia in every rank; the plan's Megacosm second appears in 6 of 246 current-patch Bronze+ games.
howitzer|midlane.alternative: Noxia before Wraith Leggings when the lane is not a kill threat (1.17 Bronze+ Noxia 55.1%).

iggy-scorch|midlane.reasoning: Turret Maniac with Vesh is the observed loadout and is retained. Every rank opens Orb Of Growth > Entropy > Megacosm, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms it (Orb Of Growth 244 games 59.0%, Entropy 57.0%, Megacosm third 63.0%). Megacosm, the plan's opener, was unchanged in 1.17; in every rank it is bought third against health stacking, not first.
iggy-scorch|midlane.alternative: Hold This! with the same items (50.9% Gold+) scales Molotov damage for longer games.

morigesh|midlane.reasoning: Cursed Infestation with Vesh is the best observed Gold+ loadout (47.9% vs 44.0%) and is retained, including its 1.17 Hive and Curse buffs. The purchase order is corrected: every rank opens Combustion > Lifebinder > Megacosm, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms it (Combustion 177 games 53.1%, Lifebinder 104 games).
morigesh|midlane.alternative: Timewarp opener appears in Bronze+ (1.17: 60 games, 53.3%).

renna|midlane.reasoning: Netherward with Vesh is the dominant, strong loadout (1.16 Gold+ 52.4% over 8,267; Bronze+ 55.6%) and is retained. Every variant opens Entropy > Wraith Leggings > Overseer; the plan's Megacosm opener is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (40 games, 35.0%) while Overseer reaches 52.1% over 284 games.
renna|midlane.alternative: Netherward with Lotus (53.6% Gold+) for a snowball game; Lich + Millennia is the most-played blessing pair.

wraith|midlane.reasoning: The plan combined a magical augment, an attack-mark Eternal and magic items. Observed magic Wraith is the weakest setup in every rank (1.16 Gold+ 40.2%, Bronze+ 40.2%, Silver+ 39.8%, Platinum+ 43.3%), while physical Sniper's Bounty holds up (Gold+ 48.9% over 730, Platinum+ 52.1% over 709). Alternator adds 15% damage to the Alternate shot whose kills pay out through Sniper's Bounty; Vanquisher moves later because it is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (65 games, 35.4%).
wraith|midlane.alternative: Sniper's Bounty with Lotus (Flawless + Prima Donna; Platinum+ 54.7% over 404) avoids Satariel's health cost; 1.17 trimmed Satariel.
wraith|midlane.limitation: Wraith Mid performs below 50% in most ranks; 1.17 Bronze+ physical samples are small.

argus|midlane.reasoning: The plan is the observed Infinite Obliteration + Vesh build (1.16 Silver+ 51.6% over 2,986, Platinum+ 53.4%) with the observed Azure Core > Entropy > Wraith Leggings core, confirmed in 1.17 Bronze+ (Azure Core 336 games, Entropy 53.5%, Wraith Leggings 54.5%). Lich was trimmed in 1.17; Tithe of Death is the stated alternative.
argus|midlane.alternative: Mana Catalyst with Vesh (52.7% Gold+) for mana-independent trading.

gideon|midlane.reasoning: Event Horizon with Vesh is the best large Gold+ variant (54.0% over 4,086 in 1.16) and the items match every observed core, confirmed in 1.17 Bronze+ (Azure Core 633, Combustion 445, Wraith Leggings 57.0%). The 1.17 reductions (Event Horizon 5%->4%, Void Breach, Black Hole) trim damage without changing the build logic. A reviewed 18-level order already exists.
gideon|midlane.alternative: Infinite Impact with Vesh is the most-played setup (51.3% Gold+).

grim-exe|midlane.reasoning: No Statz role sample in any rank and 22 current-patch Bronze+ games; nothing tests or contradicts the plan.
grim-exe|midlane.limitation: Almost no sample in any rank.

ikra|midlane.reasoning: Evidence conflicts. 1.16 Statz favours The Gloom (Gold+ 51.3% vs the plan's Cascade 46.1%), but the observed Combustion > Wraith Leggings path is poor in 1.17 Bronze+ (40.6% and 40.3%), while the plan's Prophecy opener fits Cascade's attack-speed payoff (23 games, 69.6%). No change is justified on this evidence.
ikra|midlane.alternative: The Gloom with Vesh and a Combustion > Wraith Leggings > Noxia core (1.16 Gold+ 51.3%).
ikra|midlane.limitation: Ikra Mid performs below 50% in most ranks; conflicting and small current-patch samples.

valmont|midlane.reasoning: Current 1.17 Bronze+ data supports the plan's spell path: Azure Core first wins 54.1% over 412 games and Overseer 59.3% over 209, while the attack-speed Entropy/Prophecy route trails (44.4% and 46.6%). The current source disagrees with the official launch text on Bloodbound's attack-speed buff and slow, Arterial Grip's attack-speed steal (10-30% vs 20-40%), and basic-attack scaling (total vs bonus physical power); its Exsanguinate healing and Sanguine Banquet match the official numbers in different wording. The plan does not use attack speed, basic-attack scaling or Lilith item procs, so those conflicts do not affect it. The caution is updated because a current-patch sample now exists.
valmont|midlane.alternative: Magnify fourth (1.17 Bronze+ 54.9%) against magic-armour stacking.
valmont|midlane.limitation: Valmont Mid performs 45.5% over 433 1.17 Bronze+ games; no Gold+ sample. Bloodbound, Arterial Grip and basic-attack scaling remain disputed between the official launch text and the current source; the plan does not depend on them.

maco|midlane.reasoning: Experimental role: 6 current-patch Bronze+ games and no Statz page in any rank. The loadout is valid but role strength cannot be established.
maco|midlane.alternative: Maco Support is the established role.
maco|midlane.limitation: Experimental role with no usable sample; kept out of automatic suggestions.

scarlett|midlane.reasoning: Experimental role: 6 current-patch Bronze+ games and no Statz page in any rank. The loadout is valid but role strength cannot be established.
scarlett|midlane.alternative: Scarlett Jungle or Offlane are the observed roles.
scarlett|midlane.limitation: Experimental role with no usable sample; kept out of automatic suggestions.

legion|midlane.reasoning: New role in the current data with no authored plan: 471 Bronze+ games in 1.16 (Scorched Earth + Vesh, 49.7%), 53 current-patch Bronze+ games, and no Gold+ sample. No plan is invented on that evidence; the labelled most-played observed variant is the fallback.
legion|midlane.alternative: Observed: Malady > Deathstalker > Spear Of Desolation with Vesh (Bronze+ only).

adele|offlane.reasoning: The plan opened with the tank template Fire Blossom > Dynamo > Flux Matrix, but Dynamo appears in 1 of 123 current-patch Bronze+ games and Flux Matrix in none. Every rank opens Fist Of Razuul > Elafrost > Earthshaker (1.16), and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms Fist Of Razuul first (60 games, 56.7%). Fist turns Adele's health into periodic damage that suits Tyrant of Thorns' amplified Crown of Thorns. The Knell loadout is unobserved but unrefuted and is retained.
adele|offlane.alternative: Tyrant of Thorns with Krix (Festering Wounds + Cannibalism) is the observed loadout (48.9% Gold+).

akeron|offlane.reasoning: The plan's tank items match the observed Nihil tank builds, which lead in Gold+ (52.9% over 935) and Platinum+ (54.1% over 848), while Krix appears only with magic items (48.1% Gold+). 1.17 lowered Akeron's magical-power scaling on every ability and raised Crushing Maw's bonus-health scaling, which favours tank Akeron.
akeron|offlane.alternative: Death From Above with Xyris and a Magnify-led magic core (52.3% Gold+) before the 1.17 magical-power reductions.

aurora|offlane.reasoning: Glacial Thorns leads the plan's Hypothermia in Gold+ (51.5% vs 45.8%) and Silver+ (53.3% vs 51.5%). Every rank opens Magnify > Elafrost > Flux Matrix; the plan's Fire Blossom opener appears in 17 current-patch games. Festering Wounds turns Aurora's roots into anti-heal, and the crystal root adds another immobilize for Glacial Thorns.
aurora|offlane.alternative: Hypothermia with Krix is the most-played setup (Silver+ 51.5%) for an armour-shred, anti-attack-speed lane.

countess|offlane.reasoning: Every variant in every rank opens Orb Of Growth > Noxia > Lifebinder, and 1.17 Bronze+ confirms it (Orb Of Growth 83 games 57.8%, Noxia 57.0%, Lifebinder 61.5%). The plan's Megacosm opener appears in 15 current-patch games. The Sanguine Slash + Vesh loadout is observed and retained.
countess|offlane.alternative: Shadow Echo with Vesh (50.9% Gold+) repeats the swap damage.

greystone|offlane.reasoning: Close Cut with Krix beats Close Cut with Thraex in every rank (1.16 Gold+ 55.8% over 2,669 vs 51.8%; Bronze+ 56.0% vs 54.8%; Silver+ 57.3% vs 54.1%; Platinum+ 53.7% vs 47.7%). Krix's health scaling feeds Greystone's sustained front line. Augmentation stays second because it is strong in 1.17 Bronze+ (247 games, 59.5%), with Aegis Of Agawar third (194 games, 57.7%). Regenerative Tissue replaces the commonly paired Voracity: the published and current source definitions of Voracity describe different effects (healing from hero damage versus a max-health heal and gold on unit kills), so this plan does not rely on it.
greystone|offlane.alternative: Tainted Oath with Krix (54.1% Gold+) blights a whole team; Imperial Soul with Krix led Platinum+ (57.2%).

sevarog|offlane.reasoning: Grim Harvest with Krix is retained. Unholy Pursuit led it in three ranks in 1.16 (Gold+ 51.4% vs 45.0%), but its soul reward differs between the published (3 souls) and current (2 souls) source definitions with no official note, so the lead may not survive and the switch is not made. The item order is corrected: Fist Of Razuul first, because the Fire Blossom opener is weak in 1.17 Bronze+ (149 games, 44.3%) while Fist reaches 58.1% over 74; Tainted Guard is the observed third item in every rank.
